versions.changelog:
Channel groups no longer change the guide's channel order.

Earlier versions forced a name-only sort name on every channel in a collection so the collection would list alphabetically. Jellyfin sorts the Live TV guide by that same name, so grouped channels dropped out of channel number order. The plugin now leaves channel sort names alone and clears the override on the next Apply. Collections still list their channels alphabetically: each channel in a collection gets a premiere date in name order and the collection sorts by premiere date, which the guide does not use.

Install / upgrade: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adamef93/jellyfin-live-tv-collections/main/manifest.json under Dashboard > Plugins > Repositories, install or update Live TV Channel Groups from the catalog, and restart Jellyfin.

Full changelog: https://github.com/adamef93/jellyfin-live-tv-collections/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

League schedule matching now picks up NFL RedZone.

RedZone covers every game at once instead of naming one, so a League schedule filter used to drop it. A RedZone stream from an unfiltered channel group still joined, but copies from filtered groups (for example a DAZN channel group) did not. NFL League schedule matching now counts a channel or program titled "RedZone" or "Red Zone" while an NFL game kicks off during it, so a leftover RedZone channel outside NFL game windows stays out.

Install / upgrade: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adamef93/jellyfin-live-tv-collections/main/manifest.json under Dashboard > Plugins > Repositories, install or update Live TV Channel Groups from the catalog, and restart Jellyfin.

Full changelog: https://github.com/adamef93/jellyfin-live-tv-collections/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1

Build groups from your tuner's own channel groups, and match real games with league schedules.

Channel groups
- New "Channel groups" match mode: build a group from the channel groups your tuner's M3U playlist defines (its group-title; with Dispatcharr, these are its channel groups), combining as many as you like.
- Every channel in a ticked group joins. Tick "filter" next to a group to take only its channels that also match the group's keywords or league schedule. For example, take the NHL team channels whole while filtering a mixed ESPN+ group down to hockey games.
- Groups are read from the tuner's channel list as of the last guide refresh. If they can't be read, the plugin skips that apply pass instead of emptying your collections.

League schedules
- New "League schedule" match mode, also available as a channel-group filter: pick leagues instead of writing team-name patterns. Presets: NFL, College Football, NBA, WNBA, Men's and Women's College Basketball, NHL, Men's and Women's College Hockey, MLB, MLS and the Premier League.
- A channel or program matches when its title names both teams of a scheduled game ("Georgia vs. Alabama", "College Football : Georgia at Alabama", "NHL.TV: Flyers @ Bruins") and the guide has it starting within 90 minutes of that game. The time check is what tells a football game from the same two schools' volleyball match, which services like ESPN+ title identically.
- Schedules come from ESPN's public scoreboard, fetched only for the leagues you use and cached for an hour. If a schedule can't be fetched, the plugin uses the cached copy or skips that apply pass.

Other changes
- The plugin is now listed in the dashboard sidebar, under Plugins.
- The settings page shows the installed version.
- Channels in a collection now sort by name; previously Jellyfin's sort name put the channel number first.

Existing keyword groups keep working unchanged.

Install / upgrade: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adamef93/jellyfin-live-tv-collections/main/manifest.json under Dashboard > Plugins > Repositories, install or update Live TV Channel Groups from the catalog, and restart Jellyfin.

Full changelog: https://github.com/adamef93/jellyfin-live-tv-collections/compare/v1.2.2...v1.3.0

Collections now sort by name, and removing a group can delete its collection.

Collections the plugin manages are now ordered by name instead of Jellyfin's default premiere-date order, which was arbitrary for channels. Existing collections are fixed on the next apply.

"Remove group" now asks for confirmation and has an "Also delete this group's Jellyfin collection" checkbox. Without it the group is removed on Save and the collection stays; with it the collection is deleted immediately.

Install / upgrade: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adamef93/jellyfin-live-tv-collections/main/manifest.json under Dashboard > Plugins > Repositories, install or update Live TV Channel Groups from the catalog, and restart Jellyfin.

Full changelog: https://github.com/adamef93/jellyfin-live-tv-collections/compare/v1.2.1...v1.2.2

The program lookahead setting is now in days (default 7, max 30) instead of hours.

Existing configs that stored a value in hours are converted automatically (rounded up to whole days) and switch to days the next time you save the settings page.

Install / upgrade: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adamef93/jellyfin-live-tv-collections/main/manifest.json under Dashboard > Plugins > Repositories, install or update Live TV Channel Groups from the catalog, and restart Jellyfin.

Full changelog: https://github.com/adamef93/jellyfin-live-tv-collections/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1
Per-group match preview panel on the config page; the program-matching option now shows the current lookahead window (Program lookahead setting, 168 hours by default).
Groups can optionally match upcoming guide program names as well as channel names, with a configurable lookahead window (default 168 hours).
Initial release: keyword-based channel tagging, optional Collection sync, scheduled task, live auto-apply on channel add/update, and a small REST API for previewing matches and triggering a re-apply.
